sections.text:
The method 
 compares the intensity of light scattered by the sample with the intensity of 
 light scattered by a standard reference sample (formazine polymer suspension) 
 under defined conditions. The higher the intensity of light scattered at
 90C to the path of incident light, the higher 
 the turbidity. Turbidity can be determined for any aqueous sample that is free 
 of debris and rapidly setting materials.

The most common interference are dirty 
 glassware, air bubbles in the sample, vibration that disturb the surface of 
 the sample and color due to dissolved substances.

The first draft initiated by chem.Yasser Lotfy 
 Zahra tested by chem. Mahmoud Elshrkawy, reviewed by general manager 
 chemist Anis Abu Elez, revised by quality control chemist Wael A. Tantawy at 
 EDEPC. and accepted by eng. Monier EL Wakel, head sector of Damietta P.S.

Read

Samples and Standards are presented in capped cells to minimize the

Photo detector: Silicon diode with enhanced blue response.
Light source: Tungsten filament light source 5V. 230 mA.

Main 
 display: 3 digit LCD.

Range keypad: This switch read with the decimal point indicating the selected 
 range, also set the ca/value.

Read 
 keypad: Initiates measurement sequence, the display will clear for 3 seconds 
 and then reading.

I/0 
 keypad: On / Off for the unit, three short tones will sound before display.

Zero 
 keypad: Calibrates to the theoretical value for pure water - 0.02 N.T.U.

Cal 
 key pad: CAL is displayed when the key is pressed, the unit will calibrate to 5.00 
 N.T.U if the 
 pq 
 keypad is used to change the value. When the read keypad is 
 pressed the unit will calibrate to the new value.

pq 
 keypad: 
 Lower range 0.20 to 19.99 N.T.U. Upper range 2.0 to 199.9 N.T.U.

Datalogging keys: These keypads are 
 inoperable if option is not fitted.

The unit provided

 months when opened, it must be kept out of freezing, contamination. It is 
 possible to use Formazine
 as a calibration standard. Recent 
 studies have found that formazine carcinogenic. If formazine is used, all

THE USE OF FORMAZINE IS NOT RECOMMENDED

To obtain 
 optimum performance the followings should be observed:

items:
Calibration 
 standard close to the expected analyte.

Use 
 only clean, dust and scratch free sample cells.
Ensure the cell is filled to the neck.
External surface should be free from fingerprints and moisture.

Air 
 bubbles should be removed by gentle inversion.

A 
 filter ( blank or colored ) should be fitted into the filter compartment at 
 all times.

Pure 
 filtered water should be used. For general measurements the use of a 
 deionised water is satisfactory.

During use the lamp is only switched on when the sample is being measured 
 thus helping to conserve battery life.

Switch 
 the unit on by pressing the I/0 keypad. The display will read and three 
 tones will sound, select the required range by use of range keypad.

Prepare a zero solution and place it in a clean turbidity cell, place it in 
 the sample compartment and close the sample area lid. Ensure the etched line 
 on the glass of turbidity cell is in line with the marker (0).

Press the Zero keypad, the display will clear for 3 seconds prior to a 
 reading displayed, a single tone will sound at the start.
Remove the zero solution from the sample chamber.

Prepare a calibration standard and place in a clean turbidity cell, place 
 into the sample compartment.

Press the Cal keypad, a single tone will sound and the display will read 
 calibration. If required, the 
 pq
 keypads should be set to the desired 
 CAL value.

Press the Read keypad to initiate the measurement sequence, a single tone 
 will sound and the display will clear for 3 second, a tone will sound at the 
 end of the measurement sequence.
